messages:
Priya Rao: Hi all 
Priya Rao: Our baby arrived early (34w) and is in the NICU. My paid parental leave is scheduled through 2031-02-14 but discharge might be later. Two quick asks: 1) is there a company NICU top-up or extension policy? 2) I have frequent pumping needs 1 want to reserve lactation room time near office for when I come in for appointments. Also my device auto-collection is due while Im out, can that be deferred?

Maya (People Ops): Priya, congrats and so sorry about the NICU stay  sending hugs. :heart: Yes, we offer a NICU accommodation: up to 6 weeks additional company-paid top-up for primary caregivers with documented neonatal hospitalization. Steps: upload the NICU/physician note to the secure form, sign PHI consent, and tell us if youm filing STD. We'll provisionally approve same day when docs are received.

Maya (People Ops): Link: https://intra.redwood/hr/forms/medical-leave-extension (choose "NICU/premature"). After upload we generate a consent link for PHI. Payroll timing depends on cutoff.

Priya Rao: Uploaded note (ref nicu-2031-0042). Discharge estimate 2031-02-25. Consent signed.

Payroll Bot: Received nicu-2031-0042. Payroll cutoff: approvals before 2031-02-10 included in 2031-02-15 run, else next. Top-up treated as supplemental pay and taxed normally.

Ethan (Eng Lead): Priya  we got you. I can reassign your high-priority tickets and cover oncall initially. Suggest we bring a short-term contractor for 4 weeks to cover feature work. I have budget to approve contractor up to 6 weeks.

Priya Rao: Appreciate it  thank you. For lactation room  I might need to come into the office for pump sessions a few times while visiting NICU. Can we reserve a dedicated slot or keycard access?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, we can reserve a room and set temporary keycard access. I'll loop Facilities to add a recurring reservation and grant access for your badge.

Asset Ops: Noted  we can pause auto-collection for asset RDW-PRI-209 until 2 weeks after your confirmed return date. Please DM asset tag and we'll place the hold.

Priya Rao: Asset tag DM'd. Thank you.

Maya (People Ops): Also, if you want a phased return we can record a ramp plan (options: 3 weeks 50% or 4 weeks 60%). Top-ups apply only during approved leave, not during ramp, but we can discuss a short-term accommodation for partial pay during ramp if needed.

Priya Rao: Im leaning toward 3 weeks at 50%. Will confirm expected start-of-ramp once discharge is closer.

Legal: Quick note  if you want job protection (FMLA/CFRA) we need medical documentation that indicates need for parental leave due to neonatal hospitalization. People Ops will assist with filing.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) provisional NICU top-up pending final review (case PO-2031-42); 2) place asset hold; 3) request Facilities to reserve lactation room and temporary keycard; 4) schedule 15-min sync with Priya + Ethan tomorrow to confirm coverage.

Priya Rao: Thanks everyone  truly helpful. Really appreciate the lactation room support and quick turn on top-up.

Ethan (Eng Lead): Sending a short handover template in the thread and will update calendar for oncall swaps. :thumbsup:

Maya (People Ops): Follow-up: Facilities reservation made (Lactation Room 2) and keycard access queued. Payroll notified to queue provisional top-up once People Ops finalizes approval. We'll reach out in 24 hours to confirm.
